 Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 7th Court, Paschim  Medinipur in M.A.C. Case No. 261 of 2017 under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

CAN 1 of 2022 This is an application for stay of operation of impugned judgment and award dated 20th June, 2022 passed by learned Additional District Judge cum Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 7th Court, Paschim Medinipur in M.A.C. Case No. 261 of 2017 under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

entities.text: Additional District Judge cum Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 7th Court, Paschim Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By order dated 20th June, 2022 the learned tribunal granted compensation of Rs.52,20,917/- in favour of the claimants and opposite party No. 2 (mother of the deceased).
Ms. Sucharita Paul, learned advocate for appellant-insurance company submits that in relation to the self-same accident an award was passed in favour of the claimants (respondent Nos.1,2,3, & 5) in M.A.C. Case No. 183 of 2016 disposed of by learned Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 1st Court, Hooghly (Sadar) at Chinsurah.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 1st Court, Hooghly (Sadar) at Chinsurah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The insurance company has also in compliance to the order The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Rupa Banerjee & Ors on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195693598/
2 passed in the said case deposited cheques in favour of the respondent Nos. 1,2,3, & 5.

entities.text: Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Rupa Banerjee & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Out of four cheques deposited in favour of the claimants respondent No. 5 Kamala Banerjee has already withdrawn her cheque from the learned tribunal.

In spite of such order passed in M.A.C. Case No.
183 of 2016, the instant claim application being no. 261 of 2017 was proceeded with by the claimant without disclosing the order passed in their favour in the earlier claim application.
Thus surreptitiously the respondents could succeed in getting two awards of compensation in their favour by acting fraud upon the court.

In support of her contentions, she files photocopy of award passed in the claim application being M.A.C. Case No. 183 of 2016 as well as the information slips dated 21st March, 22nd December, 2022 and the copy of the claim application in M.A.C. Case No. 183 of 2016.
In the aforesaid backdrop she prays for stay of operation of impugned judgment and award.

As per the report of the Computer Section, Appellate Side, High Court,
Calcutta dated 8th September, 2022, no caveat has been lodged.

The report of the office dated 5th November, 2022 shows deposit of statutory amount of Rs.25,000/-with the Registry of this Court in terms of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act vide OD challan no. 1920 dated 19.9.2022.

Upon perusal of the documents submitted on behalf of the appellant-insurance company it is primarily found that in relation to the self-same accident an earlier application being M.A.C. Case No. 183 of 2016 was filed by respondent No. 5 before the learned Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 1st Court, Hooghly (Sadar) at Chinsurah.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 1st Court, Hooghly (Sadar) at Chinsurah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The said case was allowed on contest and an award of Rs. 24,00,000/-together with interest was passed in favour of the claimant (i.e. respondent No. 5 herein) and proforma opposite parties (respondent Nos. 1,2 & 3 herein) on 24th January,
2022.

Though such award was passed in favour of respondent Nos. 1,2,3 & 5 none of the parties disclosed such award passed in their favour during proceedings in M.A.C. Case No. 261 of 2017 and ultimately an award of Rs.52,20,917/- was passed in favour of respondent Nos. 1,2,3 & 5 on 20th June, 2022.
That being the position I am inclined to grant an order of stay of the impugned judgment and award.
There shall be stay of operation of impugned judgment and award for a period of four weeks.
Mrs. Paul, learned advocate for appellant- insurance company seeks liberty to file supplementary affidavit.
Liberty is granted Appellant is directed to serve copy of the application upon the respondents and file affidavit- of-service on the returnable date.
Let the matter appear on 21st April, 2023 under the heading "Applications".
